name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when getting a waterfront home valuation?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when getting a waterfront home valuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A common pitfall is relying solely on tax assessments or online estimates, which often don't reflect the true market value of unique waterfront properties. Another is failing to disclose recent upgrades or specific waterfront amenities, such as a new dock or seawall, which can lead to an undervaluation. It's also important to ensure the valuer has specific experience with waterfront properties in your area, as they understand the nuances of water frontage and local market demands. Not presenting all relevant information can impact the accuracy of the assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid relying on inaccurate online estimates, failing to disclose upgrades, or choosing a valuer without specific waterfront experience.
